title: Sleep Study
concept: A volunteer in a paid sleep study watches the overnight footage and sees herself get up, walk to the camera, and whisper something every night at 3:07.
setting: Sleep clinic: bedrooms, monitoring room, corridor.
conflict: Mara needs the money; the study needs her to stay.
escalation: Night 1: she stands. Night 2: she walks to the camera. Night 3: she whispers. Night 4: the audio is enhanced — she is giving instructions to someone off-camera. Kwame stops showing up.
reveal: The study isn't measuring sleep. It's recruiting whatever answers through sleepers; Mara's whispers are its replies.
ending: Mara leaves, paid. At home she sets up her own camera. At 3:07, two figures stand up.
emotional_objective: Slow-burn paranoia with a complete, satisfying reveal.

hooks.line: I joined a paid sleep study. Then they showed me the footage.
hooks.first_visual: Grainy night-vision: a figure sits up.

hooks.line: Every night at 3:07, I walk to the camera. I don't remember any of it.
They enhanced the audio. I was giving someone directions.
I signed up for one more night.

originality_review: Original. Avoid resemblance to found-footage films; no borrowed scenes.
